name: Grade 6 T1 Practice: May Week 3 - Awareness Product
description: Practice words for planning and presenting an awareness product.

words.definition: The people a message is made for.
An idea or information someone shares.
words.example: The poster message was to recycle batteries.
The title told people the topic.

words.definition: Something true that can be checked.
words.example: The student added one fact about e-waste.

words.definition: A short piece of helpful advice.
words.example: The slide gave one tip about reusing devices.
The action was to bring old batteries to a safe place.

words.definition: A visual message with words and images.
words.example: The poster shared one internet rule.

words.definition: A visual that explains information with pictures and short text.
words.example: The infographic showed how to reduce e-waste.

words.definition: To show and explain work to others.
words.example: The student presented the poster to the class.
